column2: Teenage girl Amicia escorts her little brother Hugo through Inquisition-era medieval France, hiding from soldiers and swarms of rats that devour anything not in torchlight. Grim, sibling-focused, stealth with a sling.
Sequel: Amicia and Hugo flee south to a sunlit Mediterranean island, still hunted, still drowning in rat tides. Prettier and sadder than the first.
Strictly two-player co-op with a permanent split screen. Two convicts, Leo and Vincent, break out of prison together and go on the run. Cannot be played alone.
Classic RTS where you gather resources, build a town and summon Greek, Egyptian and Norse gods and mythical units. Top-down base builder, not a character game.
Modern remake of the Greek/Egyptian/Norse RTS. Base building, worker units, god powers called down from above.
Arcade brawler pitting Colonial Marines against xenomorphs and Predators. Sci-fi horror action, side-scrolling beat em up.
First person shooter with three separate campaigns: marine, alien and predator, each with different vision modes. Dark corridors, motion tracker beeping.
Top-down action RPG in the Zelda mould where a dream-walking boy enters people's nightmares to solve dungeon puzzles. Notoriously tough puzzle design.
First person survival horror with no weapons. You hide in wardrobes from monsters, manage lamp oil and sanity in a dark castle.

Online social deduction on a cartoon spaceship. Little bean-shaped crewmates in coloured spacesuits do maintenance tasks while one or more impostors secretly murder them and lie in meetings. Massive 2020 meme game.
Minimalist puzzle game whose rules are written on screen as pushable word blocks. Shove the words to rewrite the laws of the level. Extremely clever, very hard.
Co-op horror set in endless yellow wallpapered office liminal spaces. Find exits, avoid entities, buzzing fluorescent lights.
Nintendo 64 3D collectathon platformer starring a honey bear who carries a red-crested bird in his backpack. Jigsaw pieces, musical notes, cartoon humour, witch villain Gruntilda.
Open world superhero brawler in a walled-off prison district of Gotham. Freeflow melee combat, cape gliding, detective vision.
Military first person shooter with a comedic squad and heavily destructible buildings. Modern war setting.

First person shooter set in Rapture, a collapsing 1960s art deco city on the ocean floor built by an objectivist millionaire. Plasmid superpowers, Big Daddy diving suits guarding creepy Little Sister girls who harvest ADAM. Would you kindly.

FromSoftware action RPG in Yharnam, a gothic Victorian city of gaslight, top hats and cobblestones overrun by blood-plagued beasts. Trick weapons, aggressive dodging, cosmic Lovecraftian turn late on. Brutally hard.
Puzzle platformer with painterly watercolour art where you rewind time to solve each level. Melancholy story about a man searching for a princess.

column1: Call of Duty 2: Big Red One
column2: Second World War first person shooter following an American infantry division through Africa and Europe.

Precision pixel-art platformer about Madeline, a young woman climbing Celeste Mountain while confronting her anxiety and depression, personified as a dark double. Punishing but kind, instant respawns, chiptune-adjacent piano soundtrack.
Arcade driving game where you ram criminal vehicles off the road against a timer.
Super Nintendo JRPG about a group of friends travelling between prehistory, the middle ages, the present and a ruined future to prevent an apocalypse. Akira Toriyama art.
City-building simulation. Zone residential and industrial districts, lay roads, manage traffic and budgets. No protagonist.
Run-and-gun boss rush drawn and animated in the style of 1930s rubber hose cartoons, with a jazz soundtrack. Two mug-headed brothers collecting soul contracts for the devil. Famously difficult.

Open world RPG in Night City, a neon-drenched future California metropolis of chrome implants and corporate gangs. You play the merc V, with rockstar terrorist Johnny Silverhand, played by Keanu Reeves, living inside your head as a digital ghost. Disastrous launch, later redeemed.

Slow, punishing third person action RPG in a decaying dark fantasy kingdom of Lordran. Bonfires, estus flasks, stamina-managed sword combat, shortcut loops, cryptic online messages. The original souls-like.
Third entry in the souls series. Faster combat, ash and fire, crumbling cathedrals, huge bosses. Still famously difficult.
Post-apocalyptic delivery hiking game. Sam, played by Norman Reedus, carries towering stacks of cargo across an empty America, balancing on rocks and rivers, with a baby in a jar on his chest.
Wrestling and brawling game starring hip hop artists fighting in clubs and subways.
The first FromSoftware souls game, set in the fog-bound kingdom of Boletaria. Nexus hub, world tendency, brutal difficulty.

Isometric detective RPG with no combat. You are an alcoholic amnesiac cop in the run-down city of Revachol investigating a hanging, and the twenty-four separate parts of your own psyche argue with you in your head as voices. Oil-painted art, enormous amounts of dialogue.
Fast first person shooter. A space marine shotguns demons on Mars. Heavy metal, gore, no reloading.
Sequel to the demon shooter, now on Earth, adding the super shotgun.

column1: Dream Daddy: A Dad Dating Simulator
column2: Visual novel dating sim where a single father romances other fathers in his neighbourhood. Comedic.
Short comedic deduction game where you play a trenchcoated duck detective filling in blanks in a case report.
Third person shooter about blasting building-sized ants and spiders in a city. Deliberately cheap and silly.

FromSoftware open world dark fantasy. Ride your spectral horse Torrent across the Lands Between, fight enormous bosses, die constantly. Written with George R. R. Martin. Notoriously difficult, enormous.

Top-down automation and logistics game. Crash-landed on an alien planet, you build ever larger factories of conveyor belts, inserters and assembly machines until the sprawling base chugs and the aliens attack. Famously addictive, the factory must grow.
Post-nuclear first person RPG in the ruins of Washington DC. Vault suits, Pip-Boy, VATS targeting, green tint.

column1: Fallout: A Post Nuclear Role Playing Game
column2: The original isometric post-apocalyptic RPG. Turn-based, retro-fifties atomic aesthetic, vault dweller searching for a water chip.

Post-nuclear RPG in the Mojave desert. You play a courier shot in the head and left for dead while delivering a platinum chip, then choose between factions including the New California Republic, Caesar's Legion and Mr House to control a neon-lit Las Vegas strip.
The Mojave courier RPG with all four expansions bundled.
Realistic agricultural vehicle simulator. Licensed tractors and combine harvesters, crop cycles, no story.
Boxing simulation with slow-motion punch impacts and face deformation.
Side-scrolling arcade beat em up. Mayor Mike Haggar and friends punch gangs through city streets.
Free to play sci-fi online shooter with jetpacks and mining.

First person narrative game. Henry takes a summer job as a fire lookout alone in the Wyoming wilderness in 1989, and his only human contact is his supervisor Delilah, who he talks to over a handheld radio. Stylised orange sunset art.
Short comedic adventure where a cheerful frog detective interviews silly animal characters.

column1: Gabriel Knight 3: Blood of the Sacred, Blood of the Damned
column2: Point and click mystery adventure in rural France involving vampires and a conspiracy. Infamous cat hair moustache puzzle.

Open world samurai game set in 1274 during the Mongol invasion of the Japanese island of Tsushima. Jin Sakai abandons samurai honour to fight as a masked Ghost. Guiding wind instead of a minimap, standoffs, drifting leaves, haiku, black and white Kurosawa mode.
Brutally fast first person parkour game in a cyberpunk tower. You wield a katana, every enemy dies in one hit, and so do you. Instant restarts, neon, wall running.

2018 Norse reboot. An older, bearded Kratos and his young son Atreus travel the nine realms on foot, arguing and grieving, with a magic throwing axe called the Leviathan that returns to his hand. One unbroken camera shot, no loading screens.
Sequel to the Norse reboot. Kratos and a now-teenage Atreus head for the prophesied end of the world. Same axe, same father-son friction.
Online social deduction game with duck avatars. Tasks, impostors, voting meetings.
Open world crime sandbox in Los Santos, a satirical Los Angeles. Three switchable protagonists, heists, cars, chaos.
Open world crime game in a neon 1980s Miami pastiche with pastel suits and synth radio.
Dark comedy management sim where you run a medieval graveyard, harvest corpses and cut corners. Farming sim structure.

Isometric roguelike where you play Zagreus, the red-haired son of Hades, repeatedly fighting your way out of the Greek underworld. Every death returns you to the House of Hades where fully voiced gods and family members comment on your escape attempt. Gorgeous character art.
Sequel roguelike starring Melinoe, sister of Zagreus, this time fighting up towards Chronos. Witchcraft, Greek underworld, same escape loop.
Short first person shooter continuation escaping City 17 with Alyx Vance. Gravity gun, headcrabs.

Hand-drawn 2D metroidvania. You are a small silent bug in a black cloak with a horned mask, wielding a sword called a nail, descending into Hallownest, a vast ruined insect kingdom beneath a dying town. Melancholy, enormous map, no quest markers, very difficult bosses.

Open world action RPG in a lush post-collapse America where enormous robotic animals roam. Aloy, a red-haired outcast huntress with a bow, unravels what killed the old world. Tribal gear against machine dinosaurs.
Surreal RPG built from claymation and photographed clay puppets. Dreamlike nonsense dialogue.
Wordless monochrome puzzle platformer. A boy in a red shirt runs right through a bleak dystopia of dogs, guards and mind-controlled bodies.
Park management sim. Build dinosaur enclosures and keep tourists alive.
Turn-based fantasy strategy RPG where a princess leads stacks of fantasy troops across a map.
Collection of the Disney and Final Fantasy crossover action RPGs. Sora, a spiky-haired boy with a giant key-shaped sword, travels to Disney worlds with Donald and Goofy.
Remaster of the first Disney crossover action RPG and its handheld prequel. Keyblade, Sora, Donald and Goofy.
Remaster of the second Disney crossover action RPG plus Birth by Sleep. Keyblade combat in Disney worlds.

column1: Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
column2: Collection bridging to the third Disney crossover game. Dream Drop Distance and a short Aqua chapter.
Minimalist side-scrolling strategy where a mounted monarch rides left and right tossing coins to recruit peasants and build walls against nightly monsters.
2D platformer where the pink puffball Kirby inhales enemies to steal their powers, exploring an interconnected mirror world.

column1: Knights of Pen and Paper II
column2: Retro pixel RPG that parodies tabletop roleplaying. You control the players around the table as well as the characters.
Children's LEGO adventure game with minifigure characters and minigames.
Gothic action adventure starring Raziel, a wraith-like undead vampire who devours souls with a spectral blade. Shifting between material and spectral realms, heavy Shakespearean narration.

Episodic narrative adventure. Max Caulfield, a shy photography student at an Oregon high school, discovers she can rewind time, and uses it to investigate a missing girl alongside her blue-haired best friend Chloe. Indie folk soundtrack, choices with consequences, famous ending dilemma.
Exploration game about an astronaut who lands on a supposedly lifeless world and finds an abandoned Soviet town.
Monochrome silhouette puzzle platformer. A boy in a shadowy forest searching for his sister, killed by traps constantly.
Cosy open world game where you play a cat knocking things off ledges in a Japanese neighbourhood.
Handheld RPG where the Mario brothers team up with their baby selves. Timed-button turn-based combat.
Grand strategy with turn-based campaign map and huge real-time medieval battles. Knights, sieges, no protagonist.
Deliberately retro 8-bit action platformer. The blue robot boy jumps and shoots robot masters, stealing their weapons. Very hard.

column1: Melty Blood Actress Again Current Code
column2: Anime 2D fighting game spun off from a visual novel. Fast air combos.

column1: Metal Arms: Glitch in the System
column2: Third person shooter starring a small wisecracking robot fighting an army of other robots on a mechanical planet.
Top-down stealth game. Solid Snake infiltrates a fortress avoiding guards' sight cones.
Stealth action on PlayStation. Solid Snake sneaks through the snowbound Shadow Moses base, hiding in cardboard boxes, talking on codec, fighting psychic and sniper bosses.

column1: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots
column2: Stealth action starring an artificially aged Old Snake with a grey moustache in a war-torn near future. Octocamo suit, extremely long cutscenes.
Remastered bundle of the stealth games. Snake, cardboard boxes, codec calls, jungle and base infiltration.
Handheld version of the Cold War jungle stealth game. Naked Snake hunts in 1960s Soviet forest, camouflage and hunting animals to survive.
Episodic choice-driven adventure set in the blocky Minecraft world.
Third person action game about hunting enormous wyverns in a fantasy ecosystem, then crafting armour from their parts. Long fights, sharpening weapons, no plot to speak of.
Handheld entry in the giant monster hunting series. Climb monsters, craft gear from carved parts.
Portable giant monster hunting. Track wyverns across zones, harvest materials, repeat.
Expanded portable monster hunting with a felyne companion. Famously grindy and difficult.
Japan-only portable monster hunting entry with a hot spring hub village.

column1: No One Lives Forever 2: A Spy in H.A.R.M.'s Way
column2: Comedic 1960s spy first person shooter starring British superspy Cate Archer. Gadgets, mod fashion, silly villains.
Adventure game where your soul transmigrates between bodies in a cyberpunk city. Features David Bowie.

First person space exploration mystery. You are a four-eyed alien astronaut in a rickety wooden spaceship exploring a tiny hand-made solar system, and the sun goes supernova every twenty-two minutes, resetting everything except your knowledge. Nothing gates progress but understanding. Campfires, marshmallows, banjo.
Colourful team-based hero shooter. Objective maps, distinct characters with ultimate abilities.
Role-playing game where Mario is a flat paper cut-out in a pop-up storybook world. Timed-hit turn-based battles.
Adventure where a papercraft Mario fights folded enemies using a ring-based puzzle battle system. Origami and confetti.
Co-op mountain climbing survival game where a small group scrambles up a hazardous peak together.
Chinese fantasy massively multiplayer online RPG with flight and character customisation.

Courtroom visual novel. You are a spiky-haired rookie defence lawyer investigating crime scenes then cross-examining witnesses in court, slamming the desk and shouting Objection while pointing, presenting evidence to expose contradictions. Comedic, anime art.
Cartoon lane-defence strategy. Plant sunflowers and pea shooters on your lawn to stop waves of comic zombies.
Collectible card spin-off of the lawn defence game.

column1: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time
column2: Acrobatic third person platformer in a Persian palace where a dagger lets you rewind a few seconds after a fatal mistake. Wall running, sand monsters.
Darker sequel with heavy metal soundtrack and a pursuing time monster called the Dahaka.
Nintendo platformer where Princess Peach takes the lead role, changing costumes to gain abilities in a theatre.

column1: Professor Layton and the Unwound Future
column2: Puzzle adventure where a top-hatted English gentleman and his apprentice solve standalone brain teasers inside a time travel mystery.

Ocean survival crafting game. You start on a tiny wooden raft with a hook, dragging in floating debris while a shark repeatedly bites chunks out of your platform. Co-op, building outward across an endless flooded world.
Cartoon sci-fi third person platform shooter. A furry Lombax mechanic and his small robot sidekick use absurd weapons across planets.

Open world western as Arthur Morgan, a dying outlaw in a collapsing gang in 1899 America. Slow, heavy, meticulously simulated: skinning animals, mud, campfire songs, and the widely mocked detail that horse testicles visibly shrink in cold weather.
Science fiction first person shooter with destructible terrain on Mars.
Open world Mars shooter built around demolishing buildings with a sledgehammer and explosives.

First person survival horror. Ethan Winters searches a rotting plantation estate in rural Louisiana for his missing wife, stalked by the cannibalistic Baker family. Opens with found-footage video tapes made by a TV crew, and you play some sections as the camera operator.
Infamously bad biker action game.
Real-time strategy expansion spanning human history with territory borders.
Anime school-themed 3D fighting game with team attacks.
Side-scrolling beat em up starring two schoolgirls punching their way through a city to rescue their boyfriends. Pixel art, comic panels.

column1: Saints Row: Gat Out of Hell
column2: Open world comedy spin-off set in a cartoon hell with wings and demonic guns.
Third person action game based on the stylised cartoon about a samurai flung into the future.

FromSoftware action game in a reimagined Sengoku-era Japan of the late 1500s. You are Wolf, a one-armed shinobi whose severed left arm is replaced by a mechanical prosthetic that fires grappling hooks, shuriken and flame. Posture-breaking sword duels demand perfect parry timing rather than dodging, there is no difficulty setting and no summoning help, and it is widely considered the hardest game FromSoftware has made. Resurrect on the spot once per life. Castles, pagodas, rooftops, ninja stealth.

Minimalist action game in an empty forbidden land. There are no ordinary enemies at all: you ride your horse Agro across vast emptiness to find sixteen enormous colossi, then climb their fur and hide like moving terrain to stab their weak points. Melancholy, morally uneasy.

column1: Shower With Your Dad Simulator 2015: Do You Still Shower With Your Dad?
column2: Joke arcade game about matching a running child to the correct father.
Amusement park management sim. Build rides, set ticket prices.

Deck-building roguelike. You climb a tower floor by floor, choosing branching paths, adding cards and relics to a deck that gets stronger and more fragile, and the final boss of the third act is a giant beating Heart. Turn-based card combat, four characters.

Third person Second World War sniping game in Italy. Its signature is a slow-motion X-ray killcam that follows the bullet into the target and shows the skeleton, organs and tissue rupturing on impact.
Earlier entry in the wartime sniping series set in Berlin, with the same slow-motion anatomical bullet camera.
Modern military sniping shooter in jungle and desert. Ghillie suits, wind and drop.

column1: South Park: The Fractured But Whole
column2: Turn-based RPG animated exactly like the cartoon, parodying superhero films. Crude humour.

Cosy management game where you play Stella, the ferrymaster who takes over from Charon, sailing a growing boat to collect animal-spirit friends, care for them, and eventually take each one to the Everdoor to let go. Hand-animated, explicitly about grief and dying.
Rail shooter where an anthropomorphic fox pilots an Arwing starfighter against an ape villain. Polygonal space combat.
Remake of the on-rails space shooter with a talking fox squadron. Do a barrel roll.
Third person adventure where the fox pilot explores a dinosaur planet on foot with a magic staff.

Pixel-art farming and life sim. You quit a soul-crushing corporate job at Joja and inherit your grandfather's overgrown farm in a small town, then plant crops through the seasons, fish, mine, befriend the villagers and can date and marry one of them. Relaxing, endlessly moddable.

column1: Story of Seasons: Trio of Towns
column2: Farming and romance life sim across three neighbouring villages. Crops, livestock, courtship.

Third person adventure where you play an ordinary orange stray cat, separated from its family, wandering a neon walled cybercity populated entirely by small robots in clothes, with a drone companion on your back. You can meow, knock things over and squeeze through pipes. No humans left.

The 1985 side-scrolling platformer that defined the genre. Mario, a short moustachioed Italian plumber in red and blue overalls, stomps turtles and mushrooms through the Mushroom Kingdom to rescue Princess Toadstool from Bowser, a giant spiked turtle, only to be told the princess is in another castle.
3D platformer where the plumber travels the world in an airship with a sentient hat that lets him possess enemies and objects, collecting moons, chasing Bowser who is trying to marry Princess Peach.
3D platformer on a tropical island where Mario cleans graffiti with a water-spraying backpack.
Handheld platformer where Princess Peach rescues Mario, using exaggerated emotions as powers.
Grim top-down roguelike where a naked crying child fights through a basement of biblical body horror, throwing tears at monsters.

column1: The Chronicles of Riddick: Escape from Butcher Bay
column2: First person stealth-action prison break starring Vin Diesel's character, with eyeshine vision in the dark.
Pixel art comedic point and click about a detective investigating supernatural cases.

column1: The Last of Us Part II
column2: Brutal third person post-apocalyptic drama about revenge, following Ellie and Abby through overgrown Seattle. Infected, stealth, heavy emotional violence.

column1: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past & Four Swords
column2: Handheld version of the top-down Super Nintendo adventure with a multiplayer mode. Link, master sword, light and dark world.

column1: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
column2: Open world adventure where Link wakes after a hundred years and is dropped into all of Hyrule at once. You can climb literally any surface until your stamina runs out, paraglide down from anywhere, cook meals from foraged ingredients, and weapons break constantly. Shrines instead of dungeons, Divine Beasts, no waypoints forcing a route.

column1: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
column2: Nintendo 64 adventure where a young boy in green travels through time with a magic ocarina to stop Ganondorf. Z-targeting, Hyrule Field, Water Temple.

column1: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword
column2: Motion-controlled adventure with floating sky islands and a skyward-pointing sword. Link and Zelda as childhood friends.

column1: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
column2: Darker Zelda where Link transforms into a wolf in a shadowy parallel Twilight realm, with an imp companion called Midna.

column1: The Operative: No One Lives Forever
column2: Stylish 1960s spy shooter with a female British agent, lounge music and comic henchmen dialogue.
Life simulation expansion adding a futuristic world with hoverboards and robots.

Open world fantasy RPG. Geralt of Rivia is a mutated monster hunter for hire with white hair, cat-like eyes, scars and two swords on his back, one steel and one silver, who travels a muddy war-torn eastern-European-flavoured world taking contracts, playing the card game Gwent, and searching for his adopted daughter Ciri. Morally grey quests, no true good endings.
Amusement park business sim. Set prices, hire staff, watch guests be sick.
Tactical squad shooter with cover mechanics, set around Las Vegas casinos.
Gritty origin reboot of the archaeologist adventurer Lara Croft, shipwrecked on a stormy Japanese island. Bow, climbing axe, survival tone.

Isometric adventure starring a tiny fox in a green tunic with a sword and shield. Its central mechanic is that you gradually find pages of an illustrated instruction manual, written mostly in an invented untranslatable language, which slowly teaches you the game's real secrets. Hidden depth, obscure puzzles.
Cinematic third person action adventure. Nathan Drake, a wisecracking treasure hunter, climbs ruins and shoots mercenaries chasing pirate treasure.

Slapstick sandbox where you play a horrible goose harassing the residents of an English village, stealing their belongings, honking and ruining their days. Debussy piano soundtrack, checklist of pranks.
Arena brawler where giant kaiju monsters fight each other and level city blocks.
Two-player co-op puzzle game where each player sees different information and must describe it over radio to escape a castle.
Cartoon sci-fi massively multiplayer online RPG with telegraph-based combat on a lost planet.
Expansion to the fantasy MMO that reshaped the old world after a dragon's return. Raids, questing, flying mounts.
Turn-based tactical strategy defending a city from alien infiltration, with base management.
Sprawling JRPG about a young man, giant mechs called Gears, and dense religious and psychological plot. 2D sprites on rotating 3D maps.
